package main
import("context";"encoding/json";"fmt";"io";"os";"ponder.local/ponder-go/config")
func main(){
 raw,err:=io.ReadAll(os.Stdin);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 base,err:=config.ParseSourceConfiguration(raw);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 _=context.Background;_=json.Valid
input:=config.SourceTypedContract[string,string]{Chain:config.SourceOnChains(config.SourceChainOverride{Name:"mainnet"}),ABI:json.RawMessage("[{\"name\":\"Event0\",\"type\":\"event\",\"inputs\":[{\"type\":\"bytes32\",\"name\":\"arg\",\"indexed\":true}]},{\"name\":\"Event1\",\"type\":\"event\",\"inputs\":[]}]"),StartBlock:"16370000",EndBlock:"16370100"}
typed:=config.SourceTypedConfiguration[config.SourceTypedContract[string,string]]{Base:base,Name:"a",Contract:input}
built,err:=config.BuildSourceConfig(base,config.SourceBuildOptions{});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
indexing,err:=config.SafeBuildTypedSourceIndexing(context.Background(),typed,built,[]config.SourceIndexingFunction{{Name:"a:Event0",Fn:func(){}}});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if len(indexing.EventCallbacks())!=1{panic("actual typed chain/callback result changed")}
 fmt.Println("actual typed source pipeline passed")
}
